sources.label: The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory? (Friston 2010, DOI)
sources.sourceBasis: Added 2026-07-14 to give citations.json entry friston-2010-free-energy-principle its own correct source (previously mismatched to the learning-foundations-arxiv entry, which pointed at an unrelated paper). Karl J. Friston (2010), Nature Reviews Neuroscience, has no arXiv preprint; the DOI resolves to the Nature article (verified via direct fetch -- title, journal, and year match). Nature.com occasionally bounces automated requests through a cookie-consent redirect (same class of flakiness as the linkedin entry) -- genuinely reachable, recorded as ok:true.
